seo.description: A custom window and sliding door draw natural light into this ensuite, featured in Australian House and Garden, 2010.

content:
To draw natural light into this ensuite, which is part of the renovation of an old Melbourne home, a window and sliding door comprising panels of clear, opaque and translucent glass were used to open up the bathroom to the outside courtyard.

![Australian house bathroom with a view of the outside](/src/assets/media/australian-house/2010/01/12west.jpg)

> With views of the greenery and the sky, bath time is even more relaxing.
